scripts.dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); if(!fs.existsSync('frontend/dist/index.html')){ cp.execSync('npm --prefix frontend run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }" && node server.js
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), cp=require('child_process'); if(!fs.existsSync('frontend/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js')){ cp.execSync('npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev', {stdio:'inherit'}); } cp.execSync('npm --prefix frontend run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){ fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); }"
